chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Yaqoub ibn Yazeed, from Al-Ghufari, from Al-Qasim ibn Ishaq, from his father, from his grandfather, who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'A sign of the Pleasure of Allah, the Exalted, among His creatures is the justice of their rulers, and the cheapness of their prices; and a sign of the Anger of Allah, Blessed and Exalted, upon His creatures is the inequity of their rulers, and the expensiveness of their prices.'
ai.seo_question: What are the signs of God's pleasure and anger regarding economic justice in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi underscores the Shia concept of 'Adl al-Sultan' (justice of the ruler) as a divine indicator, linking macroeconomic stability directly to spiritual well-being. It reflects the scholarly view that inflation is not merely an economic phenomenon but a sign of divine displeasure resulting from political injustice, a theme central to discussions on governance in Shia political thought.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Al Ghufary, from Al Qasim Bin Is’haq, from his father, from his grandfather who said,

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘A sign of Pleasure of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the exalted among His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures is the justice of their Sultan (ruling authority), and cheapness of their prices (low inflation); and a Sign of the Anger of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High upon His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures is the inequity of their Sultan (ruling authority) and the expensiveness of their prices (high inflation)’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ya’qub Yazid from al-Ghifariy from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad ibn Ishaq from his father from his grandfather who has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘

Of the signs of happiness of Allah, most High, with His creatures is the existence of a just ruler and low prices. Of the signs of unhappiness of Allah, most High with His creatures is the existence of an unjust ruler and high prices.’”
